They're both hacking. Hacking never should have come to mean "system breaking". We already have a perfectly appropriate word for that: cracking. All cracking is hacking but not all hacking is cracking.

The term Hacker was coined by students at MIT in the dim and distant mists of time, of which Stallman (Peace Be Upon Him) was one. He defined hacking as "Playfully doing something difficult, whether useful or not, that is hacking."

So technical, the more modern definition is more correct with the original spirit of the definition.

The term was misappropriated by some films in the popular culture, such as Wargames and, erm, Hackers.
